text:
Noah S.: morning everyone :wave: first day question — where do 'company-wide' Notion templates live? I only see team folders under Engineering > Templates. Also: who has the authority to promote a template to org-wide so other teams can reuse it?

Tara (DevEx): welcome Noah! :tada: Company-wide templates are under Workspace > Templates > Company-wide (read-only). Link: https://redwood.notion.site/Company-Templates. Promotion to company-wide requires Docs Curator signoff — we review for duplication, scope, and security.

Noah S.: the Company-Templates page I can open but it has no owner listed. who is the curator?

Lena (Docs Curator): hey @Noah S., that's me — Lena (Docs Curator). If you want a template promoted, duplicate your draft, fill the "Template Promotion" form (https://forms.redwood.com/template-promotion) and add: purpose, teams impacted, minimal examples. We triage weekly.

Juno (Eng Manager): small tip: include a short compatibility matrix at the top of the draft (which runtimes, infra setups, and access levels it assumes). we tend to reject promotions that are tightly coupled to a single repo.

Noah S.: thanks. is there a naming convention for company templates so we don't collide with team templates?

Tara (DevEx): yes. Use: [Company] - [DocType] - [ShortDesc] - [v#]. e.g., "[Company] - Runbook - ServiceBoot - v1.0". Keep a metadata header with Owner, Version, Last edited, Status, and Compatibility.

Lena (Docs Curator): process overview: 1) Draft & duplicate a template (never edit the master). 2) Add metadata block and test examples. 3) Submit promotion form. 4) Curator review (dup check + legal/security if needed). 5) If approved, curator renames and locks the master, updates the index, and sets Space permissions to view-only for non-editors.

Noah S.: good to know. what locking means practically? do only curators edit the master afterwards?

Lena (Docs Curator): masters are view-only for normal editors. To update, you submit a patch: duplicate the master into a "proposed changes" page, then comment with @Lena + "Patch for vX". We then apply the change or schedule a maintenance window for breaking edits.

Noah S.: we have a bunch of old checklists in our team folder. what's the archival policy so they don't clutter search results?

Tara (DevEx): archived templates move to Templates/Archive and get the tag "archived" with a short reason and archived date. notion-sync-bot excludes archived items from the main index. If something should be restored, file a restore request referencing the archive path.

Noah S.: last q — how do I get temporary edit rights to the company templates for the review period?

Lena (Docs Curator): choose "Curator-reviewed edit" on the edit-request form (https://forms.redwood.com/notion-edit-request). We'll grant timeboxed access tied to the promotion request and monitor the change log. DM me if it's urgent and include your request ID.

notion-sync-bot: Indexer - Weekly template index refreshed; 1 pending promotion (req-20260311-89).

Noah S.: perfect, submitted the promotion form and requested temp edit rights. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
